bullets.text: Nvidia Targets AI Companies — Nvidia is reportedly acquiring Hugging Face for $13 billion, aiming to strengthen its position in the open-weight AI model market and reduce reliance on major tech firms.
Meta Enhances Privacy Features — A new update for Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses prevents users from disabling the privacy LED, aiming to improve transparency when recording.
DuckDuckGo Reveals AI Risks — A survey shows many users share personal information with AI chatbots, often unaware of privacy implications, highlighting a need for better user education.
Smartphone Prices Set to Rise — Analysts predict permanent price hikes in smartphones due to rising memory costs, affecting consumer choices and limiting access to low-end devices.
Meta's Ongoing Privacy Challenges — Meta continues to address privacy concerns with its smart glasses, as it faces scrutiny over how it manages user data and device functionality.
